Your information

Privacy Policy

Demo policy — review and customise before publishing.

This starter website does not include a server-side customer database or analytics system. The enquiry form prepares an email draft in your email app; it does not send it automatically. Your email provider may process the message if you choose to send it.

If you later add accounts, analytics, payment processing, cookies, or order storage, update this policy to explain what data is collected, why it is used, who receives it, how long it is retained, and how customers can request access or deletion. Publish accurate business contact details and obtain suitable legal advice for your business and location.

Please read

Terms & Conditions

Starter template — not legal advice.

Product descriptions, availability, and prices shown here are examples and must be verified before use. An enquiry is not a confirmed order. Any real order should be confirmed with the customer, including the product, final price, delivery charges, payment method, and expected delivery time.

Before launching, add your actual rules for cancellations, returns, refunds, warranties, intellectual property, customer complaints, and applicable law. Do not publish terms that do not reflect how your business operates.

Protecting customers

Security & Trust

This static HTML demo has no user accounts, payment gateway, or server-side order database. It cannot guarantee protection against every threat. For a real online store:

Secure Hosting

Use HTTPS, keep your hosting platform and dependencies updated, and restrict access to the hosting account.

Admin Protection

Use a real server-side login, strong unique passwords, multi-factor authentication, role-based permissions, and rate limiting.

Customer Safety

Never store card details in this HTML file. Use a reputable payment provider and collect only the customer information you need.

Important: a password or admin panel built only into a public HTML file is not secure. Anyone can inspect or change browser-side code. Real authentication, product management, and order records require a secure backend.
